description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates and Exchange with effect from 23.01.2023 to 29.01.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. The content involves statutory powers, regulatory compliance requirements, and the rescinding of a previous legal notification, which falls squarely under Type 5 classification for legal and regulatory matters.
